lesson: Once the official order of play identified Michael Zheng as Cameron Norrie's sole first-round opponent, the open-field player forecast collapsed to a nearly deterministic answer. For presupposed match-result questions, the completed draw can be more informative than player-strength modeling because only the named opponent can satisfy the resolution wording.

The forecast conflated the headline southwestern semiconductor fab with the question's specific value-chain stage. The Honam project had shifted toward front-end fabrication, while packaging and substrate expansion belonged to Samsung affiliates in the Chungcheong area, including Asan and Cheonan. For multi-region industrial packages, map each named activity—fabrication, packaging, substrates, displays and data centers—to its own site, and forecast the official regional label rather than assuming constituent cities will receive credit.
